sinopsis.es: Parte de los hechos de abril de 2024, cuando una reunión entre docentes y su sindicato terminó en caos y violencia física, para reflexionar sobre los desacuerdos que han roto la relación entre los educadores y los organismos que los representan.
sinopsis.en: The film uses the events of April 2024 - when a meeting between teachers and their union descended into chaos and physical violence - as a starting point to reflect on the disagreements that have led to a breakdown in the relationship between educators and the bodies that represent them.
